extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Qompass AI's remote device provisioning server: an MCP server (stdio transport, rmcp, MCP modern era 2026-07-28) holding the household fleet's device inventory and diagnostics for Android, Windows, and iOS, with package install/update and reboot behind a pure decide() gate that requires operator approval, and a per-device capability model that refuses what a platform cannot do. iOS is served by a full MDM (check-in, command queue, SCEP, APNs push); at Stage 0 the MDM command model and queue exist and delivery lands in Stage 1. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Bosun does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Bosun

skills.description: Register and inspect provisioned devices: platform, transport, iOS enrollment state, and the declared capabilities the gate enforces per device.
skills.name: Device inventory

skills.description: Read-only device diagnostics bundles and package listings for Android, Windows, and iOS — ungated, because they change nothing.
skills.name: Diagnostics and package listing

skills.description: Install and update packages on declared-capable devices (ADB, winget, MDM InstallApplication), each call decided by the operator-approval gate before any backend runs.
skills.name: Package install and update

skills.description: Reboot devices whose platform declares the capability, behind the same operator-approval gate.
skills.name: Device power

skills.description: The mutation gate itself: ask for the decide() verdict on an action, device, and approval without performing the action.
skills.name: Mutation gate verdicts
